text.p: Transport and trading company Internatio-Mueller NV said on Thursday it was buying CBG Chemie Beteiligungsgesellschaft mbh (CBG), a Cologne-based distributor of speciality chemicals.
The Dutch company gave no financial details of the acquisition but said CBG had total sales of 200 million guilder and 100 employees.
Internatio said it would strengthen its European position as a distributor of speciality chemicals through the acquisition of CBG, which has units in Germany, the Netherlands, France and Italy.
CBG handles more than 60 chemical products in various markets including paint, artificial materials, rubber, pharmaceuticals and cosmetics.
Annual turnover in Internatio's chemicals trading business would rise to 700 million guilders a year after including the acquisition of CBG. -- Amsterdam newsroom +31 20 504 5000, Fax +31 20 504 5040
